say_hello_for_ip.description: Get the word for hello in the language of the country an IPv4 address is in, such as a visitor's or a sign-up's address. Private addresses and ones HelloSalut cannot place come back as 'Hello' with 'found' set to false. No API key required.
say_hello_for_ip.display_name: Get hello for an IP address
say_hello_for_ip.display_str_template: Get hello for the IP address {0}.
say_hello_for_ip.name: say_hello_for_ip

parameters.description: An IPv4 address, such as 81.2.69.142. HelloSalut cannot read IPv6 addresses.
parameters.name: ip_address

country_code.description: For a country or IP address lookup, the two-letter code of the country the greeting is for, e.g. 'GB'. Empty for a language lookup.

found.description: True when HelloSalut had a greeting for what was asked. False means 'hello' is the English fallback.

hello.description: The word for hello, e.g. 'Salut' or 'こんにちは'. When HelloSalut has no greeting for what was asked, this is 'Hello'.

language_code.description: For a language lookup, the language HelloSalut matched, e.g. 'fr'. Empty for the other lookups.

language_name.description: For a language lookup, the language's name in English, e.g. 'French'. Empty for the other lookups.

matched_by.description: What the greeting was chosen by: 'language', 'country' or 'ip'.

query.description: What was looked up, tidied: a language code ('fr'), a country code ('DE') or an IPv4 address.

summary.description: One line with the greeting, e.g. "'Salut' is hello in French".

say_hello_in_country.description: Get the word for hello in the main language of a country, from its two-letter code such as 'DE' or 'JP'. Countries HelloSalut has no greeting for come back as 'Hello' with 'found' set to false. No API key required.

mock_response.summary: 'こんにちは' is hello in JP

say_hello_in_language.description: Get the word for hello in a language, from a language code such as 'fr' or a browser language tag such as 'fr-CA' (a regional variant HelloSalut lacks uses its base language). Handy for greeting a contact in their own language. Unknown languages come back as 'Hello' with 'found' set to false. No API key required.
